narrative: OMX30 enters Thursday with a cautiously constructive setup despite mixed European opens. Asia's overnight strength (Nikkei +122bp, Hang Seng +113bp) provides positive momentum, while the headline correlation signal (+0.202%) remains constructive. The index sits +6.7% above its 200-day MA in confirmed bull regime, though ADX's weakness (12.0) demands humility on magnitude—technical confidence is capped. Stochastic oversold conditions (K=7.2) and neutral RSI (52.94) suggest tactical bounce potential, but MACD remains below signal with histogram at -8.577, indicating sellers have not yet capitulated. USD/SEK weakness and sharp yield compression (-113bp in US 10Y) create cross-currents: exporters benefit from softer SEK, but multiple compression pressures tech and real estate. Key watch: today's US Jobless Claims at 14:30 CET could reignite rate volatility.
morningBrief: OMX30 opens on constructive Asian tailwinds and structural bull setup, but technical momentum is flagging—MACD below signal and ADX weak at 12.0 argues for 0.3–0.5% upside rather than aggressive rally. Core drivers: (1) Nikkei/Hang Seng strength rolls over; (2) Stochastic deeply oversold offers mean-reversion trade; (3) Gold +1.30% underpins Boliden; (4) USD/SEK weakness aids exporters (Volvo, Atlas Copco, Ericsson) but EUR/SEK also weakens, pressuring H&M. Yields collapsing (-113bp in US 10Y) removes some tech/REIT headwinds but signals risk-off undertones. Trade tactically long into oversold conditions targeting 3140–3160 (200-MA resistance ~3180), but trim above 50-MA. Watch for any escalation in trade commentary ahead of US data at 14:30 CET—VIX still elevated at 14.89 despite recent -600bp decline. Banks (SEB, Handelsbanken) face NIM compression from yield collapse.

topRisk: Yield collapse may be overdone; mean reversion risk in US 10Y if labor data disappoints (claims rise > 235K). This could trigger a VIX spike and broad risk-off, reversing today's gains. ADX weakness (12.0) means low-conviction setup—any negative surprise could wipe out the technical bounce quickly.
